segments.text: That being thus joyned, every Church has power given them from Chriſt for their better well-being, to chooſe to themſelves meet perſons into the office of Paſtors, Teachers, Elders, Deacons, being qualified according to the Word, as thoſe which Chriſt has appointed in his Teſtament, for the feeding, governing, ſerving, and building up of his Church, and that none other have power to impoſe them, either theſe or any other.
